Q&A

Fighting (×2). Resists , immune to Ghost. Calculated from the gen 3 type chart (FireRed/LeafGreen).

Eevee evolves into Vaporeon with a Water Stone. Eevee evolves into Jolteon with a Thunder Stone; Eevee evolves into Flareon with a Fire Stone.

Locations: Celadon City (100 %, Lv 25). That's all. Eevee is limited to these spots in FR/LG. See the interactive maps for the full area view.

Our take: In FireRed/LeafGreen only the stone decides: Fire Stone (Flareon), Thunder Stone (Jolteon) or Water Stone (Vaporeon). Use it right away, waiting gains nothing. Espeon and Umbreon are impossible in FR/LG because the games have no day/night cycle.

Our take: Yes, with a plan. You get exactly one Eevee per game. The stone choice is final: Vaporeon (bulk) and Jolteon (speed) are Nuzlocke-worthy, Flareon suffers from its movepool.
